_meta.description: In-sample model error per region: ATTR_REG_FITTED adds an OLS income ~ age prediction to every customer, then AGG_MAPE (a fraction; rows with a zero actual excluded and counted in n_zero_actual), AGG_RMSE and AGG_MAE compare income with that column, named by params.prediction_field. Error on the fitted rows is optimistic; score a holdout from a compose fit with ATTR_REG_PREDICT to judge new data.
_meta.name: model_error_per_region
